request.style: English, male baritone solo, driving electric guitar, thundering drums, warm organ, cello, powerful choir backing, solemn and triumphant mood, 90 BPM
request.lyrics:
[Verse]
On the platform stood the men of old
Jeshua, Bani, and Kadmiel
Hashabneiah cried out with a loud voice
To the Lord their God in the holy place

[Chorus]
Stand up and bless the Lord your God
From everlasting to everlasting
Blessed be your glorious name
Exalted above every blessing and praise

[Verse]
You made the highest heavens and all their host
The earth and everything on it
The seas and everything in them
You give life to them all

[Pre-Chorus]
You chose Abram and brought him out
From Ur of the Chaldeans
You found his heart faithful before you
And made a covenant with him

[Chorus]
Stand up and bless the Lord your God
From everlasting to everlasting
Blessed be your glorious name
Exalted above every blessing and praise

[Verse]
We are entering a binding agreement
Put in writing by our hands
Nehemiah the governor seals it
With our priests and our Levites

[Bridge]
Hattush son of Hashabniah repaired
Next to Jedaiah in the wall
Our names are written on the sealed document
We keep your word for you are righteous

[Outro]
From everlasting to everlasting
Blessed be your glorious name
